purpose: Render a dense CRM registry with controlled selection, sorting and explicit async states.

openRow.description: Requests row detail and controlled selection.

sortChange.description: Requests a stable sort without mutating records.

accessibility.keyboard: Sortable headers are buttons; focusable rows open with Enter or Space.
accessibility.focus: Closing detail restores the originating row when it still exists.
accessibility.screenReader: Sort, selected row and every async state are announced.

motion.reducedMotion: No row translation or reorder animation.

invariants: Rows never filter hidden records in memory.
A click is not mutation evidence.
